ext.description: Automatic, per-window time tracking for each project.
view.container.title: Time Tracking
view.history.name: History
config.title: Time Tracking
config.inactivityThreshold.desc: Minutes of silence after the window loses focus before the out grace ends and the session shows as paused. The grace still counts as work if you come back.
config.bgTimeout.desc: Minutes a non-debug background process (shell command, plugin) may run without interaction before tracking pauses.
config.focusCap.desc: Safety cap, in minutes, for a session with no activity. Focused, thinking and reading count up to it. Unfocused, it also bounds the out grace: past the inactivity threshold the session pauses and counts down to this cap, then the idle tail is dropped (not counted) as a forgotten session. Must be at least the inactivity threshold (lower values are raised to it). `0` disables it (never pause while focused, and unfocused the grace is simply counted).
config.debugCap.desc: Safety cap, in hours, after which an active debug session stops keeping tracking alive without interaction. `0` disables the cap (a running debug session always keeps tracking active).
config.minSession.desc: Minutes below which a session is treated as a false start: it is discarded (not counted), however it ended. Pausing one by hand returns to awaiting confirmation rather than paused. `0` keeps every session.
config.fontSize.desc: Font size, in pixels, for the History panel. The panel's text scales from this base. `0` follows the editor font size.
config.gitUserEmail.desc: Git `user.email` used to count your commits of the day. Leave empty to read it from the repository configuration, then from the global git configuration.
config.debugLogging.desc: Write a detailed activity log (signals, decisions, recorded intervals) to the "Time Tracking" output channel and to a log file in the extension storage. For debugging only.
config.manualReasons.desc: Preset reasons offered when you add time by hand from the History panel. "Other" (free text) is always available on top of this list.
config.projectName.desc: Name used for the `{project}` token when exporting a timesheet. Leave empty to use the workspace folder name.
config.defaultReason.desc: Reason used for time that has no explicit one (plain editor tracking). Fills the `{reason}` export token for auto-tracked sessions.
config.exportColumns.desc: Columns of the exported timesheet, each as `Name={template}`. The names form the header row, and the templates fill each cell. Tokens: `{project}`, `{date}` (per the date format), `{date_start}`, `{date_end}` (start/end datetime, always with the time), `{start}`, `{end}` (HH:MM), `{total}` (H:MM), `{hours}` (decimal), `{minutes}`, `{reason}`. A column with an empty template is a blank cell, and unnamed columns drop the header.
config.exportSeparator.desc: Character that joins the export columns (and the header). Default `,` for CSV.
config.exportDateFormat.desc: Format of the `{date}` token in the exported timesheet, rendered in the machine's local time. `iso8601` is a bare date. The zoned presets (RFC 3339, RFC 1123, RFC 1123 numeric, RFC 850) carry the row's start time and timezone.
config.exportDateFormat.rfc1123z: RFC 1123 with numeric zone, e.g. Wed, 01 Jul 2026 09:05:00 +0200
capabilities.untrusted.desc: Tracking works in untrusted workspaces, but counting git commits is disabled until the workspace is trusted.
capabilities.virtual.desc: Tracking stores data and watches files on the local filesystem, so it is limited in virtual workspaces.
